title: validation-target-configuration/1
description: The configuration under test of a validation run (TA3 plan VAL-1, spec P20 VD-9 and 3.3): the EDC settings of the target that decide what the OQ can observe. Producer: the operator, later the CommandCenter harness; owner and consumer: accuratrail-validation-framework (runners/target-configuration.ts parses it strictly, IQ-033 checks it against its source file and the EDC production example, and a retained package copies it to inputs/target-configuration.json and records it as configurationUnderTest). Flag names come only from the allowlist below and every other member has a fixed form, so no secret can enter: any other member refuses the file. Booleans state the setting as the EDC reads it; TRAINING_SERVICE_URL is only set or unset.

target.description: The API base URL the declaration describes; it must be the run's --base-url. http or https, with no credentials, query or fragment.

declaredBy.description: Who declares the configuration (a person, a role or the harness), as printable text.

source.description: The file that sets the target's environment: a compose file (its core-api service environment is cross-checked) or an env file (its KEY=value lines are). IQ-033 verifies the SHA-256 when the file is present where the framework runs.

path.description: Absolute path of the source file.

flags.description: The declared settings, at least one. Each boolean is the setting's effect as the EDC reads it (libreclinicaapi src): ENABLE_STUDY_TASK_CRON is on unless false, ENABLE_DATA_CLEANING is on when unset or true, every other boolean is on only when true.
